projects.name: Coordination: Responsible for coordinating day-to-day project operations with service providers.
details: • Technical Scope Documentation: Documenting requirements for extended ATM technology and fintech needs, including
creating technical scope documents and obtaining quotes from vendors.
• Fintech & Payment Operations: Core Banking Technologies (Loans & ATM Operations), SWIFT Workflows, ISO 20022
Modernization, Vendor Ecosystem Management.
• ISO 20022 Compliance: Driving financial messaging transformation, mapping, and global validation standards.
• Corporate Functions: Collaborating closely with the Head Accountant and possessing good experience in corporate functions.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Successfully led and collaborated with diverse teams, including engineering, marketing, sales,
and operations, to deliver the projects.
• Reporting and Approvals: Generating and delivering daily reports for the switch, reporting to management, and obtaining
approvals for system development projects.
• IT Infra Project: Experienced in delivering complete end-to-end support for IT infrastructure projects, encompassing planning,
execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, budgeting, and quality assurance.
• System Integration: Efficiently integrating new systems, programs, and applications with business operations and services.
• Performance Analysis and Improvement: Analyzing and enhancing the performance of web-based customer portals and
support services.
• End-User Proficiency: Ensuring end-user proficiency with new systems, programs, and applications across departments.
• Backlog Management: Prioritizing and managing product backlogs based on business value and customer needs.
• Central Repository Development: Designing and building a central repository database for answering all reporting requests.
• Operational and Financial Reporting: Building, maintaining, and distributing operational and financial reports using Power BI.
• Vendor Negotiation: Engaging with different vendors and negotiating effectively.
• Transformation Projects: Experience in working on various transformation projects with a functional focus.
• Tools and Methodologies: Proficiency in tools such as Jira/DevOps, MS Project, MS Excel, MS SharePoint, PowerPoint, along
with methodologies like Agile/Scrum and Waterfall.
• Documentation Expertise: Skilled in preparing various documents including FRD, BRD, SRS, cost/benefit analysis, GAP analysis,
risk analysis, and RTM.
• Technical Skills: Experience in source data analysis during migrations and developing comprehensive test plans.Hands-on
experience in MS Excel (Pivot, VLOOKUP & HLOOKUP), Power BI, test case writing, UI testing, confluence, Cyara Automation
tool, Postman, and Power BI reporting tool.
